description: A line typed into an empty rich-text field (experience description, summary, achievement) without pressing Enter shows the same text — e.g. `R&D < 5%` — in the Preview, the PDF and Word, after save and reload.

userStories.title: A single typed line reads the same in the Preview, the PDF and Word
userStories.description: As a resume author, I want a line I typed without pressing Enter to show `R&D < 5%` everywhere, so that my CV does not print `&` and `<`.
acceptanceCriteria: `renderFormattedText('R&D < 5%')` renders the text `R&D < 5%` (unit test).
`renderFormattedText('&lt;')` renders the text `<` — decoded once, not twice (unit test).
`renderFormattedText('a b')` renders `a` and `b` separated by whitespace, no literal ` ` (unit test).
`renderFormattedText('<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>')` renders the visible text `` and creates no element (unit test on the rendered markup).
`renderFormattedText('• one\n• two')` and the other existing `formatText` cases render byte-identically to before (existing unit tests pass unchanged).
The decoding function used by `renderFormattedText` is the same function `parseHtmlToDocxRuns` uses, and it references no `document`/`window` (unit test runs in the node environment).
e2e: on a seeded resume, typing `R&D < 5%` into an empty experience description without Enter, saving and reloading shows `R&D < 5%` in the Preview, and neither `&` nor `<` appears there.
e2e, same resume: the PDF from `download-pdf` contains `R&D < 5%` in its extracted text and no `&` / `<`.
e2e, same resume: the DOCX from `download-docx` contains `R&D < 5%` in `word/document.xml` text (XML-escaped as Word stores it) and no literal `&amp;` / `&lt;`.
e2e: the stored column value after the reload has not gained a layer of escaping (no `&amp;`).
FR-1: For a value with no complete tag, `renderFormattedText` decodes `  & < > " ' '` in one pass before `formatText` splits it into paragraphs and lists.
FR-2: The Preview and Word decode tagless text with one shared, DOM-free function; `docx-helpers.ts` no longer keeps its own copy.
FR-3: Decoded text is rendered only as React text nodes.
FR-4: Values with tags render exactly as before.
Regression constraint: HTML values (any value matching `/<[^>]+>/`) render byte-identically in the Preview; their DOCX runs are unchanged.
Regression constraint: Tagless values without entities render byte-identically in the Preview (existing `src/lib/format-text.test.ts` and template unit tests pass unchanged).
Regression constraint: Word output for every value is unchanged (existing `docx-helpers` unit tests and `e2e/docx-export-layout.spec.ts` pass unchanged).
Regression constraint: `e2e/rich-text-migrate.spec.ts` and `e2e/rich-text-untrusted-value.spec.ts` pass unchanged.
Regression constraint: Line height chosen by `formattedTextLineHeight` for tagless values is unchanged (they stay on the plain-text branch).
Regression constraint: Swiss template visual baselines show no diff for fixtures without entities.

Verification: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration`, `pnpm test:e2e`, `pnpm build` (or `pnpm build:verify`), `pnpm lint` compared to the tracked baseline — per CLAUDE.md §14, on the final diff.
Verification: `pnpm test:visual` for the Swiss templates, since every template renders through the changed function.
Verification: Export evidence per `.claude/rules/testing.md`: the e2e test inspects the generated PDF text and DOCX XML, not only the HTTP status.
Verification: Rendered browser evidence (screenshot of the Preview showing `R&D < 5%`) for `ui-expert`.
Verification: `code-reviewer` review including the security criterion above.
FAIL condition: The Preview, PDF or DOCX shows `&`, `<` or ` ` for the typed line.
FAIL condition: `&lt;` renders as `<` (double decode).
FAIL condition: Any decoded `<` produces an element or runs a handler.
FAIL condition: Any existing unit, e2e or visual test changes outcome, or is edited to pass.
FAIL condition: Preview or Word keep separate decoders.
FAIL condition: The fix changes what the editor stores, or stored rows.
BLOCKER condition: PR winiboy/my-cv-platform#131 changes `decodeHtmlEntities` before merge in a way this PRD does not describe.
BLOCKER condition: The e2e cannot drive the editor to store the tagless shape (e.g. the editor starts wrapping the line itself), so the regression cannot be reproduced.

Out of scope: Changing what the editor stores (e.g. always wrapping a single line in `

`). That would move single-line values onto the HTML branch and change their line height and justification in every template.
Out of scope: Migrating or rewriting stored rows.
Out of scope: Any change to values that contain tags (the `SanitizedHtml` branch), to `sanitizeHtml`, `migrateTextToHtml` or `htmlToPlainText`.
Out of scope: Bullet / numbered-list detection, paragraph splitting and justification in `formatText`, except that they now see decoded text.
Out of scope: Cover letters and any non-resume rich text.
Out of scope: Entities outside the Word set (e.g. `é`, `é`), which the editor does not write.
